## Final debug report

Problem: `gastric-handy-angelfish` duplicated the already-landed 94a3 diagnostic bug: stale attestation messages failed to name what changed.

Root cause/proof: current `origin/main` confirms the material basis is componentized in `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/material_diff.py` and `pass1.material_fingerprint()` delegates to it; checkbox state normalization makes tick-only AC edits safe (local reproduction: unticked and ticked descriptions hash equal). The prior fixed-list message came from commit `66f0220d747f6eda5cd15986d4c8659bbf88096a` under `dark-acme-lumen` (`4702-...`), so the closed bug records explicit `caused_by=dark-acme-lumen`.

RED→GREEN: a held-out pre-fix oracle on parent `34998a2ca835...` failed because the stale completion-material reason did not contain `file_impact`. On current main, `pytest tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py tests/unit/test_compute_validity.py tests/unit/test_legacy_material_grandfather_96d1.py tests/unit/test_attestation_invalidation.py tests/unit/test_plan_material_pins.py -q` passed (113 tests). Sandboxed mutation restoring the old reason made the material-diff suite RED (12 failures), proving test teeth.

Fix/land: Gerrit change 1434 (`4b5a7bcd4adf744d96ba98fcd953afa3c37d780e`) is MERGED with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. It adds signed additive `material-part:` lines, component diffs, and parity updates for claim/status/sign-review/generation/resign/child-completion/CLI surfaces. No gate outcome changed.

Step 7/replication: runtime `src/rebar` contains no `description/AC/file_impact/children` literal; enumerated refusal surfaces either now forward/name the reason or were dispositioned as already-specific (`stale-code`, `stale-head`, cryptographic key/id mismatches). Original report no longer reproduces on current main. Full `pytest tests/unit tests/integration -q` was attempted; the only failure was unrelated environment auth (`test_delete_permission_probe`: ACLI not authenticated).

Disposition: linked this ticket as `duplicates` of `linty-sunshiny-gull` / `94a3-1323-3497-4f59`, recorded explicit `caused_by=dark-acme-lumen`, and closed it as `duplicate` with a signed disposition attestation.
